construct: grid-auto-flow: row over declared columns AND declared row tracks, placement by child order
why: The one bounded auto-flow the canvas has; placement fact = order. G5′ (2026-08-08): declared row tracks coexist with ROW_AUTO_FLOW natively (GP6/GP6b) and are carried verbatim; rows OMITTED still derive as ceil(n/cols), and either way the declared list must COVER the flow (GP10).
expectWhere: anatomy.root.layout.flow = "row" WITH anatomy.root.layout.rows carried verbatim (G5′). Placement is still CHILD ORDER — no anchors carried. When `rows` is omitted the emitter's derived ceil(n/cols) x {fr:1} list is a CANVAS obligation (P9) and is never carried back.

canvas.note: The one bounded auto-flow the canvas has; placement fact = order, and rows must be DECLARED (derived ceil(n/cols)), never implicit.

codeToCanvas.note: gridItemsPositioning ROW_AUTO_FLOW; emitter declares all row tracks itself (grammar G5) — position setters are refused under flow, order IS the fact

canvasToCode.note: anchors read back computed row-major from order — deterministic; declared rows carried verbatim (G5′/GP6), conditional on rows.length >= ceil(children/columns) else grid-implicit-tracks fires (GP10)

probe: P5/P5b (enum, order-is-the-fact) + GP6/GP6b (declared rows coexist) + GP10 (the coverage bound)
